transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess... people have been saying I'm acting different. Like... sometimes I'm moving like I'm underwater. Just taking forever to get out of a chair or answer a question. Or... I don't know, other times I'm just pacing around my apartment, rubbing my hands together. Like I'm trying to shake off a bad call at work. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Have there been times when you felt unusually high or euphoric?
No. Not really. I don't... I don't really get like that.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?

I mean... sometimes, I guess. It's... mostly just work stuff. Like, I'll hear the old headset beep. Or... a voice that sounds like one of the supervisors. Just saying my name, or... telling me I'm too slow. But my laptop is closed, and... there's no phone ringing. So... yeah. Just that.
Did these problems start after a medical illness or a neurological problem?
No. I... I haven't been sick or anything like that. Just... physically, I mean. I'm fine.
When these experiences are happening, do you feel very depressed most of the day?

Yeah... I guess. I mean, when it gets really bad... when I can't sleep, and I don't really want to eat... and I just feel bad about everything... that's usually when I hear the beeps the most. And... I just can't stop thinking that the system is still tracking my time. Even though I'm not there.
Have you heard the beeps or the supervisor’s voice at times when you were not feeling depressed?

Yeah, sometimes. I mean... there are weeks where I feel okay. Like, my mood is fine, and I'm actually getting stuff done around the apartment. But... I still hear the voice then. Or... I just get this feeling that the old ticketing software is flagging my account. Even when I'm not feeling down.
Have you noticed that you've become less interested in people or activities you used to care about?

Yeah, I guess. I used to do some sketching... write down notes about different coffees I was trying. Go for hikes on the weekends. But... lately, I just... I open my notebook or put my boots on and... I don't know. I just don't feel anything pulling me to actually do it. So I just... don't.
Did these experiences come on suddenly, over a few days?
I don't really know. I guess... it wasn't like I just woke up one day and it was all there. It kind of just... built up, maybe. I'm not sure exactly when it started.
Have these problems been going on for at least 6 months?

Yeah... longer than that, actually. Um... probably around two years, maybe a little more? Two years and a few months, I think. It... it started after they let me go from my customer support job. So... yeah, it's been a while.
Was there ever a time when you heard the voice or felt the system was tracking you for at least two weeks while you were not feeling depressed at all?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... there have been a few times, maybe a couple weeks here and there, where I wasn't feeling so down. I was getting up, getting things done... but the voice was still there. That supervisor voice. And... I still felt like the old ticketing system from work was flagging me. Even when my mood was okay.
Was there ever a time when the voices or the feeling of being tracked lasted for at least one month while you were not depressed at all?

Um... no, not a whole month. Like I said... it was just a few weeks here and there. Where I felt... closer to normal, I guess. Getting things done. But the voice and the... the feeling about the software... that didn't stop. Just... not for a whole month.
Was there ever a time when the voice or the feeling that the system was tracking you lasted for at least one month?
Yeah... um, they've been going on for a while. Like... maybe a year and eight months or so. The voice and the tracking thing. It's... it's not just when I'm feeling really down, it's just... there.
